```yaml
name: Deploy Server

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  SQLX_OFFLINE: "true"

jobs:
  deploy:
    name: Deploy Server
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: "1.93.0"
          components: rustfmt, clippy

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2

      - name: Check formatting
        run: cargo fmt --all -- --check

      - name: Clippy
        run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings

      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test --workspace -- --include-ignored

      - name: Verify filter test suites
        working-directory: ./crates/tokf-cli
        run: ../../target/debug/tokf verify --require-all --scope stdlib

      - name: Check file sizes
        run: bash scripts/check-file-sizes.sh

      - name: Check for code duplication
        run: cargo install cargo-dupes && cargo dupes check

      - name: Check README is up-to-date
        run: bash scripts/generate-readme.sh --check

      - name: Build server
        run: cargo build --release -p tokf-server

      - name: Deploy to Fly.io
        uses: superfly/flyctl-actions@1.4
        with:
          fly_api_token: ${{ secrets.FLY_API_TOKEN }}
          fly_app: tokf-server
          fly_deploy_args: "--image ghcr.io/mpecan/tokf/tokf-server:latest"
          fly_env: production
```
